resolution: Fixed the sealed open doorway at the live resident boundary. The previous path omitted authored collision boxes, then position-welded the U-shaped frame into one component and boxed its full bounds, filling the portal with an invisible wall. Door compilation now derives and transmits two jamb bands plus a lintel around the measured Door Leaf aperture; the moving leaf remains its own physical rect, so opening it leaves a genuinely traversable doorway.
